name: Tsushima Reo
source:
He is a second year student from class 2-C. His room used to be a stamping grounds of his childhood friends [url=/c57]Kinu[/url], [url=/c92]Shinichi[/url] and [url=/c92]Subaru[/url]. He admires [url=http://vndb.org/c61]Kiriya Erika[/url].

He has a slightly timid character now, but formerly he was a hotblooded man. He hopes to keep his coolness after a certain event in the days of junior high school.

[spoiler] In Sunao Route, It is revealed that Sunao is his First Love. Him liking Erika is more of a crush rather than Love.  In Sunao Route for 3gakki, It is revealed that he became like this for Sunao.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tsuyokiss#Main_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
